title: My Uncle and the Rocket Launch
source_body:
My uncle was watching a SpaceX rocket video when his girlfriend walked into the room.

"Why are you watching that again?" she asked.

"I'm checking whether their rockets can really go up," he answered.

She laughed. "You should ask them to take your investment with them next time."

My uncle tried not to laugh. "I'm serious. I lost a lot."

"I know," she said. "That's why I'm making jokes. You've looked unhappy for days."

Then she sat next to him.

"It is normal to feel bad when something does not go as planned," she said. "But one bad investment does not decide your whole future."

My uncle nodded slowly.

"Do you really think things will get better?" he asked.

"I don't know," she answered. "But I know worrying all day won't make them better."

That evening, they watched the rocket launch together, and my uncle finally enjoyed it instead of thinking only about money.

My uncle was replaying a SpaceX rocket video when his girlfriend walked in. From the way he stared at the screen, it was clear that he was looking for something more than entertainment.

"Why are you watching that again?" she asked.

"I'm checking whether their rockets can actually make it up there," he answered, although he already knew the answer.

She laughed. "Next time, you should ask them to take your investment with them."

He tried not to laugh, but the joke hit too close to home. "I'm serious. I lost a lot."

"I know," she said. "That's exactly why I'm making jokes. You've looked miserable for days, and I didn't know how else to reach you."

Then she sat down next to him.

"It's natural to feel terrible when something doesn't go as planned," she said. "But one bad investment doesn't decide your whole future."

He nodded slowly, as if he was trying to decide whether he could believe her. "Do you really think things will get better?" he asked.

"Honestly, I don't know," she replied. "What I do know is that worrying all day won't make them any better."

That evening, they watched the rocket launch together, and for the first time in days, my uncle enjoyed it instead of thinking only about his losses.
